integrity: Original claims derive from the included elementary incidence proof and standalone finite-field checker; bibliographic sources are acknowledged, and no external independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Two-dimensional perfect evolution algebras, q a power of two, uniform labeled invertible matrices; not the probability over isomorphism classes, nor a result in odd characteristic or higher dimension. Finite exhaustive checks for q=2,4,8,16 supplement a general proof. Equivalent fixed-line statistics may exist in classical semilinear literature.
title: Zero–one–three law for subalgebra lines of perfect binary evolution algebras in characteristic two
